question: When did the Maharashtra government launch the 'Jail Tourism' initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is __**January 2021.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The initiative of **Jail Tourism** has been launched **by the Maharashtra government **in January 2021.
 
• It is aimed at **increasing awareness about the historical prisons** and their role in the freedom struggle.
 
• As a part of the initiative, **some parts of Yerwada Prison of Pune are opened for visitors**.
 
• The prison has the **historical significance of signing the Poona Pact**(between Ambedkar and Gandhi) and accommodating many freedom fighters during the independence movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
